info.name: EzyJob KSA Mock Interview
info.description:
AI mock interview.

Start returns the first question and a session. Answer scores the reply and asks the next question. The last answer returns the report.

No auth. The server does not store the session. Run Start, then Answer. The test script saves session for the next call.

Set base_url to local http://127.0.0.1:9001 or production http://74.208.184.175:517.

Each call can take up to 75 seconds. In Postman, set the request timeout to 0.

Restart the API after pulling this change, then call Health and confirm mock_interview is true and ollama.ok is true.

request.description: Expect mock_interview true. Read ollama.ok before starting an interview.
Returns question 1 and session. The test script stores session for Answer.
Run Start first. Send the same request again to continue. status complete means the report is ready.
